hook: Every AI session starts from zero. PromptForge brings the context your team already has.
request: Say or type a loose request. PromptForge pulls your team's specs, decisions and approved preferences from MongoDB Atlas.
brief: Every instruction cites its source, and gaps become explicit assumptions instead of guesses. Export it as Markdown to any coding tool, or preview a sandboxed website.
govern: And the memory is governed. Feedback becomes a proposed lesson that does nothing until you approve it. Decisions are versioned, outdated memory is left out, and every change is logged.
team: Alice teaches it once. Bob starts fresh on a different feature, and her lesson is already in his prompt.
access: Speak instead of typing, and keep accessibility standards like contrast and keyboard navigation in every brief.
close: Built on MongoDB Atlas, Voyage AI, ElevenLabs, OpenAI and LangSmith.
